reviews.text: We arrived to find the camp site we specifically chose multiple weeks ahead was taken. We wanted to camp on the water and celebrate my partners birthday. Unfortunately we were directed to a much larger site that wasn’t directly on the water.  This delayed us about an hour and we lost sunlight fast. Had to setup camp in the dark, and the firepit we were given had trash and debris in it. To make it up to is the camp host said we could stay as long as we wanted? But we work regular jobs and just wanted to camp on the water one night to escape our chaotic lives. Overall disappointed with organization and would not return. We don’t have a lot of money so it’s pretty upsetting when these small luxuries don’t work out. Thanks for reaching out to hear about it.

reviews.author: Linda W.
reviews.text: We booked a campsite on the last open weekend for the year in October. There was snow in forecast, but we didn't let that stop us! The lake was so beautiful in the morning and we really enjoyed the quiet scene. All of the sites around us seemed nice and secluded. I'd be interested in seeing what the place was like in summer!

reviews.author: Steven H.
reviews.text: Rustic beauty, rustic toilets. Wonderful views of Mt Hood and short but scenic hike around the lake. Pick the time you come, people out number the mosquitoes.

reviews.author: Jessica M.
reviews.text: We had a great time at Trillium Campground. Our only complaint is they need to enforce the rule that campers pick up their dogs poop.

reviews.author: Carrie  C.
reviews.text: Campground is difficult to navigate at night, I got in after dark.  Quiet campground, during September.

reviews.author: Rod H.
reviews.text: Caught several large trout and enjoyed the first couple of days.  Decided to leave one day early as there was up to 5 inches of snow forecast for that day.

reviews.author: Katherine H.
reviews.text: We had a great time camping here.  The campsites are large and have lots of trees.  The little lake is beautiful and great for kayaking.  The trail around the lake was fun but will be better once the boardwalk is repaired.

reviews.author: Richmond A.
reviews.text: Campsites were very clean and well maintained. We walked out to the lake at around midnight and the Milky Way was breathtaking! We caught the last bits of material from the Perseids meteor shower. This place gets a 10 out of 10 pine cones!

reviews.author: Ruth G.
reviews.text: Very popular and lovely campground. We found it wonderful to be there midweek in September. The trail around the lake is in the midst of some repairs but is gorgeous and worthwhile.

reviews.author: Paul G.
reviews.text:
LOCK EVERYTHING AWAY WHEN YOU GO TO BED OR LEAVE YOUR SITE!!!
Someone walk into our site while we were sleeping and stoled our camp stove, bluetooth speaker, propane tank and fishing equipment gone. Brought it to the attention of the camp hosts 2 other park employees and all they could say is " yeah it happens once or twice a week!!!

reviews.author: Susan Z.
reviews.text: Lovely site, nice spacing between campsites. Unfortunately a couple campsites down from mine there was a KARAOKE party the entire evening. Microphone and all, blasting their songs and voices. Went on right up to 10 pm which is the start of quiet hours. Seriously? Very invasive.

reviews.author: Susan K.
reviews.text: Beautiful lake and trails. Campsite was very clean and roomy. Friendly host and park ranger. Would definitely go back!!

reviews.author: Anthony A.
reviews.text: Trillium is nice decent size lake, with gorgeous MT Hood views. The camp ground is very clean and will try and stay there again this summer. I highly recommend this to anyone.

reviews.author: denice t.
reviews.text: Trillium Lake is our absolute favorite place to camp around Portland. To get a spot during high season you need to book months in advance. But it is so worth the planning. Each Camp site is big and surrounded by trees, so you don’t really feel you got neighbors. Short walk from the lake, a few minutes, depending on which camp site you’re at of course. Plenty of clean restroom, good road access and spacious parking at each camp site. Nothing beats a weekend at trillium lake!

reviews.author: Shanon A.
reviews.text: I love this place but have to give it a three simply for the bathrooms. We’ve been spoiled by Timothy Lake I suppose but these were over the top yuck 🤢.

reviews.author: Richard L.
reviews.text: Our family has been camping at Trillium for many years. It used to be a quaint little quiet lake but now it's getting way to overcrowded on the day use side. There are so many people coming up for the day that it overwhelms the paying overnight campers access to the lake. Time to look for another location. Very sad.

reviews.author: Mike K.
reviews.text: Beautiful.  Wonderful stay.  Clean facilities.  Crowded but quiet enough.  My relatives from Czechia really enjoyed it.

reviews.author: efrat r.
reviews.text: Great place, great views. If we could, we would stay longer

reviews.author: Lauren T.
reviews.text: It is a great spot - the campsite is much quieter than the day use area. The trail was under construction so we couldn't hike all the way around the lake so it loses a star. I would add day use people need to clean up after themselves better. There is a lot of litter.

reviews.author: JULIA M.
reviews.text: Absolutely perfect days at one of the most beautiful campsites in Oregon. Weather was perfect.  Our site was large enough to feel private and was steps from the lake.

reviews.author: Jason C.
reviews.text: Great location, great staff, great experience.

reviews.author: Hannah K.
reviews.text: Campsites are big for car camping. Around the lake is a perfectly flat 2 mile hike, great for kids. We love taking our inflatable kayak & floating in the lake. A drive up to Government Camp or Timberline lodge for  breakfast or dinner is a nice luxury. Super fun place to camp with kids:)

reviews.author: Brian G.
reviews.text: always a great place to visit!

reviews.author: HARRINA H.
reviews.text: Great! I would love to revisit!

reviews.author: Jane G.
reviews.text: the campsite was very uneven and was hard to find a place to pitch the tents. We couldn't find a waste water disposal. The outhouses were a long way off, difficult when your body says NOW!!! The table was not level. And the firepit was awkward to use and didn't allow cooking over the fire.

reviews.author: Raymond H.
reviews.text: This is such an easy drive from Portland. The hike around the lake is just right and the views of Mt. Hood are amazing.

reviews.author: Deborah C.
reviews.text: Great roomy sites,loved it and will definitely return!
